neighbours.label: The words ' planet' and ' galaxy', and ' system' in 'solar system'
fire: Long ago, settlers from Earth reached a distant planet and built a city.
The smugglers fled to the far side of the galaxy with their stolen cargo.
Nobody aboard had seen a planet with two suns before.
The empire ruled every world in the galaxy for a thousand years.
Pluto was once counted among the worlds of our solar system.
Her novel follows a crew stranded on an icy planet.
Astronomers found water on a rocky planet near a dim star.
A new map of the solar system shows where the old moons formed.
quiet: Long ago, settlers from Europe reached a distant coast and built a city.
The smugglers fled to the far side of the harbor with their stolen cargo.
Nobody aboard had seen a comet with two tails before.
The empire ruled every town in the province for a thousand years.
That comet was once counted among the hazards to our warning system.
Her novel follows a crew stranded on an icy shore.
Astronomers saw a brief flash near a dim star at dawn.
A new map of the city shows where the old walls stood.

predictions: planet, galaxy and solar system fire; coasts, towns, comets and a warning system in the same frames stay quiet. Whether this extends to other words for worlds is not tested.
